description: This file defines the LoanSummaryProviderDelegate class, which acts as a delegate to select an appropriate LoanSummaryDataProvider based on a provided strategy code.

classes.name: LoanSummaryProviderDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class responsible for resolving the appropriate LoanSummaryDataProvider based on a strategy code.

methods.name: resolveLoanSummaryDataProvider
methods.description: Resolves and returns a LoanSummaryDataProvider that accepts the given strategy code; throws an exception if none matches.
